root_cause.text: mac80211’s management-frame receive path accepted Beacon frames without validating that Address 1 (the destination address) was broadcast, allowing unicast Beacons to be processed as legitimate beacons and potentially bypass beacon-protection checks in `ieee80211_rx_h_mgmt_check()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an explicit drop in `net/mac80211/rx.c` before further Beacon handling: `if (ieee80211_is_beacon(mgmt->frame_control) && !is_broadcast_ether_addr(mgmt->da)) return RX_DROP;`, and the commit message says the existing BIGTK/beacon-protection logic “does not actually work” for Protected=1 unicast Beacons, so they could be accepted “even though they are not protected.”

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds an explicit drop in `net/mac80211/rx.c` before further Beacon handling: `if (ieee80211_is_beacon(mgmt->frame_control) && !is_broadcast_ether_addr(mgmt->da)) return RX_DROP;`, and the commit message says the existing BIGTK/beacon-protection logic “does not actually work” for Protected=1 unicast Beacons, so they could be accepted “even though they are not protected.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Drop non-broadcast beacon frames during management frame validation to prevent invalid beacons from being processed.
intent_record.what: A new early return was added in ieee80211_rx_h_mgmt_check() to drop incoming management frames that are beacons but do not have a broadcast destination address, before the existing AP beacon-reporting logic.
intent_record.how: At runtime, beacon frames addressed to anything other than broadcast are now discarded earlier in the RX management validation path, preventing such malformed or unintended beacon frames from being processed further.

grouping_result.intent: Drop non-broadcast beacon frames during management frame validation to prevent invalid beacons from being processed.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it adds validation to reject Beacon frames unless Address 1 is broadcast, preventing unicast beacons from being accepted in the management-frame receive path.

candidates.rationale: This pre-fix beacon-handling condition enters the AP/beacon validation path without any check that Address 1 is broadcast, which is the missing validation that allowed unicast Beacons to be accepted.
This statement identifies Beacon frames for special handling, but by itself it did not enforce the required destination-address broadcast check, enabling malformed unicast Beacons to proceed.
This condition gates beacon reporting, but it does not verify that the Beacon's destination address is broadcast, so invalid unicast Beacons could still be treated as legitimate.

vuln_statements.explanation: This line begins the AP-specific beacon validation branch, but the pre-fix logic lacked any check that Address 1 was broadcast. As a result, unicast Beacon frames could enter the legitimate beacon-processing path and bypass the intended beacon-protection validation.

This line identifies Beacon frames for special handling, but in the vulnerable code it did not enforce the required broadcast-destination constraint. That allowed malformed unicast Beacons to be accepted as valid beacons.

This gate only checks whether the beacon was already reported; it does not validate that the beacon's destination address is broadcast. Therefore, it contributed to the acceptance of unicast Beacons in the vulnerable receive path.

Author: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>
Date:   Fri Nov 4 11:18:18 2011 +0100

    mac80211: report OBSS beacons
    
    If there's an interface in AP mode, OBSS beacons
    are needed by hostapd/wpa_s to implement logic to
    enable/disable protection etc. Report the frames
    and set the capability flag.
    
    Signed-off-by: Johannes Berg <johannes.berg@intel.com>
    Signed-off-by: John W. Linville <linville@tuxdriver.com>

diff --
bic_trace_step.reason: The shown function only adds OBSS beacon reporting in AP mode: `if (rx->sdata->vif.type == NL80211_IFTYPE_AP && ieee80211_is_beacon(mgmt->frame_control) && !(rx->flags & IEEE80211_RX_BEACON_REPORTED)) { ... cfg80211_report_obss_beacon(...); }`. It does not show the vulnerable acceptance logic from the root cause (missing validation that Beacon Address 1 is broadcast), and it does not add any check for `mgmt->da`/Address 1 being broadcast. Since the vulnerable construct is absent from this snippet, this function body is not itself exhibiting the bug and it also does not contain the fix for that bug.
